name: UK Sole Trader Tax Workbook
thesis: UK sole traders pay £5–9 on Etsy for a spreadsheet that maps their expenses to the SA103 boxes, estimates tax and Class 4 NI and now carries the MTD quarterly totals; a 2026/27 workbook sold through Etsy's own checkout (Etsy bills and remits VAT) earns from the shelf's existing buyers with no infrastructure and no marketing.
